item.text: {"claim_count":23,"content_failure_reasons":["The fiscal-buffer claim has a malformed and contradictory unit: the extract reports a combined total of USD 262 billion, not an amount denominated as \"MXN-equivalent 262 billion USD.\"","The 2.9% GDP-growth claim is mislabeled as year-over-year; the extract describes accumulated growth through November 2022.","The 7.1% private-consumption claim is mislabeled as year-over-year; the extract describes accumulated growth through October 2022."],"content_usable":true,"material_omission":true,"material_omission_explanation":"The map omits the extract's statement that budget revenues remained 1.5% of GDP above budget after the IEPS subsidy, the administration-to-date creation of 1.3 million IMSS jobs and its comparison with the Calderón and Fox periods, and the ministry's claim that reduced financing costs and exchange-rate/interest-rate exposure supported sustainable debt.
